answer: In an agent marketplace, jobs might commission a sonnet, depict a sable, or inspect a ledge. Allocation votes are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, not by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents gives exactly the same voting weight as one agent holding 100. To gain influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital rather than merely generating identities.
